svg.title: Distributed Key-Value Store Architecture Blueprint (Dynamo / Cassandra)
svg.desc: Architectural blueprint of a decentralized distributed key-value store showing a consistent hash ring with 3-AZ replication, quorum coordinator path, LSM storage write and read pipeline, sloppy quorum hinted handoff, and Merkle tree anti-entropy repair.
svg.text: Distributed Key-Value Store: Ring, Quorums, LSM Path & Anti-Entropy
Decentralized Dynamo/Cassandra topology (N = 3, W = 2, R = 2) with AZ-aware preference lists, hinted handoff, and Merkle tree sync.

g.text: 1. CONSISTENT HASH RING & COORDINATOR QUORUM (N=3, W=2, R=2)
Preference list skips duplicate physical hosts/AZs so N=3 spans 3 fault domains.
2. PER-NODE STORAGE ENGINE PATH (LSM-TREE + BLOOM FILTERS)
